name: Restyle
lines: Restyle this building: colours, walls, roof, door, windows, sign and the inside
Your building. What you pick shows at once; press Save and everyone sees it.
As the Keeper you can restyle any building in Somnucor; your word overrides the owner's.

The buildings you can restyle. Walk to one (or step inside) and press 🎨 Restyle, or pick it here.
